title: Yummy Hunan Pork Stir-fry
description: A buttery, silky pork stir-fry with smoky Hunan flavors, fresh redcurrants, and a dash-friendly sauce.
instructions: Slice the pork into 1 cm strips and season with salt and pepper.
Whisk together 1 tsp cornstarch and 2 tbsp water to make a slurry.
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a wok over high heat until smoking.
Add the pork strips and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until browned and cooked through; remove to a plate.
In the same wok, add the remaining tablespoon of sesame oil, then sauté minced garlic and ginger for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the sliced scallions, redcurrants, and chili paste, cooking for 1 minute.
Pour in soy sauce, oyster sauce, and rice vinegar, stirring to combine.
Return the pork to the wok, toss to coat with the sauce, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the cornstarch slurry, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens to a silky glaze.
Remove from heat, adjust seasoning with additional salt or pepper if needed, and serve immediately over steamed rice or noodles.
